INSERT INTO store_ratings (seller_name, marketplace, rating_score, rating_grade, best_match_seller, best_match_score, product_count, overall_score, match_score, rated_at) VALUES
(#{r.sellerName}, #{r.marketplace}, #{r.ratingScore}, #{r.ratingGrade}, #{r.bestMatchSeller}, #{r.bestMatchScore}, #{r.productCount}, #{r.overallScore}, #{r.matchScore}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating_score = VALUES(rating_score), rating_grade = VALUES(rating_grade), best_match_seller = VALUES(best_match_seller), best_match_score = VALUES(best_match_score), product_count = VALUES(product_count), overall_score = VALUES(overall_score), match_score = VALUES(match_score), rated_at = NOW()
